title: A rescue includes safe transport and follow-through

applicability.game_version: Observed in RimWorld 1.6; revalidate behavior for the current game.
applicability.mods: RimMolt and ordinary gameplay; details can vary by version and other enabled mods.

observed: A carried casualty passed through fire and was dropped, adding injuries.
explanation: The chosen transport path exposed both rescuer and patient to a continuing hazard.
recommendation: Inspect the whole route and stabilize or relocate treatment where safer.
exceptions: Emergency exposure can be justified when every option is dangerous; make the tradeoff explicit.
verify: Confirm patient location, new damage, bleeding and actual bed arrival after each consequential move.
review: Reviewed source account; retain provisional status and avoid universal tactical claims.
